title.zh: Meta to create a new class of shares to fund AI push
title.en: Meta to create a new class of shares to fund AI push

current_state.zh: Meta will issue a new non-voting class of shares, trading from 2027, to fund its AI buildout, potential acquisitions and employee compensation, as disclosed in its Q3 2026 earnings report.
